description: Vehicle 1 goes straight through an intersection. Vehicle 2 approaches from the opposite direction of Vehicle 1 and turns left across Vehicle 1’s path. Vehicle 3 approaches from the perpendicular road to the right of Vehicle 1’s approach and turns right onto Vehicle 1’s exit road. Vehicle 4 is traveling in the same direction as Vehicle 1 and starts behind Vehicle 1 in an adjacent lane. Vehicle 4 changes lanes into Vehicle 1’s lane after the intersection. A bicyclist travels in the center of Vehicle 1’s lane on the exit road.
